option_relations.rationale: The option 'Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS)' is a direct match to the disease described in the leaf, which specifies HFRS due to Hantaan virus infection with associated complications.
While COVID-19 is mentioned in the vignette, the primary diagnosis described in the leaf is HFRS, not COVID-19 itself. The leaf does not represent COVID-19 as the main diagnosis.
Acute Kidney Injury is explicitly mentioned as a component of the HFRS diagnosis in the leaf, indicating it is a complication or feature of the primary disease.

The leaf describes HFRS due to Hantaan virus infection. While the vignette mentions positive COVID-19 tests, the leaf does not represent a coinfection of Hantaan virus and SARS-CoV-2 as the primary diagnosis, but rather focuses on the HFRS presentation.
